summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a proposed offering of 3,000,000 shares of 9.50% Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock at $100 per share stated amount. The filing details dividend and redemption terms, including an 18-month hard call at 110%, with subsequent step-downs. There is no existing public market; an NYSE listing under symbol BMNP is sought. This is a routine capital-raising through a preferred stock issuance, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or other special-situations event is involved.
